title: 1823 Prairie's parlour windows drop to the door's height
items: On the Dent house at 1823 Prairie, the front's principal-floor windows now stand lower and longer, from the sill course over the landing up to the door's head, so the triple group, the narrow light and the doorway line up under one row of hoods as the Chicagology engraving and the 1883 album both draw them. The north flank keeps its own shorter windows, as the engraving shows that side.
